card.name: Words predicting nutrition-deficiency terms
card.fires_on: Linking or modifying words right before an expected nutrition term, such as 'or' after 'stunted', 'protein' before calorie malnutrition or supplementation, and 'of' before zinc deficiency. Also seen in nutrition-text citations.

modes.label: Malnutrition wording
modes.description: Words in descriptions of stunting, wasting or protein-calorie malnutrition that lead into a nutrition term.
modes.example: Every second child aged under-five (49%) in Nepal is stunted<< or>> has a low height for their age –
